author: Disney
description:
Meet the creative masterminds behind the first haute couture tri-laboration with Mattel, “Viktor&Rolf x Disney Collector Cinderella doll”. This episode takes you on a behind-the-scenes journey from the Mattel Design Centre in LA to Paris Fashion Week via the Viktor&Rolf Haute Couture atelier to see how this special collaboration came to life. Experts from across the worlds of fashion and toys come together to show how the similarities, and differences, when creative disciplines collide all while celebrating the attributes of one of fashions favourite muses, Cinderella.
